use_case_summary: Primary workload: real-time bidding (RTB) decisioning + creative personalization. Needs sub-50ms median latency, 5-20ms 95th depending on region. High QPS during peak auctions (~20k rps global), extreme cost pressure per request.
technical_requirements: Latency SLOs: median <50ms, p95 <120ms global; critical p99 behavior for fraud/abuse checks
Throughput: sustained bursts to 20k rps with autoscale and predictable reserved capacity
Model stack: mixture of commodity causal models and distilled reranker; looking at 4-bit quantization and KV cache reuse
Observability: token-level cost and latency breakdown, per-route dashboards, traces
Security: VPC peering, SAML SSO, KMS for key material, audit logs retained 1 year
poc_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): smoke test hosted API for correctness + basic latency baseline
Phase 2 (3 weeks): run Optimize suggestions — batching/caching/quantization — measure token-cost delta and tail latency
Phase 3 (4 weeks): Dedicated PoC with reserved pool in one region, canary traffic at 10%
Accept criteria: p95 within SLA, cost per 1k tokens reduced >=40% vs baseline, no functional regressions on quality evals
perf_criteria: Token-level cost target: <= $0.20 per 1k tokens for typical RTT payloads
Latency target (regional): median <= 40ms, p95 <= 110ms for US-East; similar budget for EU after routing policy
Batching impact: keep added batching latency <8ms for 90% of requests; intelligent batching only on low-priority routes
Quantization goal: move main reranker to 4-bit quant without >2% drop in relevance metric
